name: Kazuki Qualified Invoice Number for WooCommerce
author: kazukiyamashita80

sections.description:
Adds an optional or required field for 適格請求書発行事業者登録番号 on WooCommerce checkout.

  • Validates format: T + 13 digits
  • Works with WooCommerce Checkout Block
  • Stores value on the order
  • Shows in admin order screen and customer emails
  • Settings under WooCommerce → Settings → インボイス登録番号

For registered business verification, use the NTA invoice public site.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate through the ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Configure under WooCommerce → Settings → インボイス登録番号.
sections.faq:
Does this verify registration with the tax office?

No. It validates the number format only. Use the NTA public site for official status.
